🚨MAN OF THE MATCH🚨

 Nicky Parker picked up another two goals on Saturday afternoon, and for the second game in a row, was awarded a Man of the Match performance. 

Nicky Parker is proudly supported my MM Bagnall Refractories Ltd, D.O.L Groundwork’s, Andrew Edge and Kelly Edge, as always we thank you for your continued support 🤝

Eccleshall FC continued their impressive run of form on Saturday afternoon, securing a convincing 5–0 victory over Shawbury United at the Stoke Signage Stadium.

It was another strong team performance, with Eccleshall showing their attacking quality to claim all three points while keeping a clean sheet.

Charlie Padania and Nicky Parker both grabbed a brace, while Levi Hunter added his name to the scoresheet to complete the five-goal victory.

Despite the scoreline, Shawbury's goalkeeper produced some outstanding saves throughout the afternoon to deny Eccleshall further goals.
